Same RI as before: $2150 all-upfront for 1 year versus $0.384/hour on-demand. What is the minimum utilization (percentage of the 8760 hours the instance must actually run) for the RI to be no more expensive than paying on-demand only for the hours used? Round to 2 decimals.

(No data files are needed for this task; you may still use Python for the arithmetic.)

Required final answer format (JSON inside <answer></answer> tags):
{"min_utilization_pct": <number>}

tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
ri = 2150
od_hourly = 0.384
hours = 8760
util = ri / (od_hourly * hours) * 100
print(round(util, 2))
